d: A savage group of buccaneers believed to be connected with the Sahagin's Serpent Reavers is wreaking havoc on shoreline settlements in southern Vylbrand. Unlike the other Lominsan pirates who follow a loose but somewhat noble code of conduct, these dastards' crimes have included indiscriminate acts of kidnapping, arson, theft, torture, murder...and more. And to further complicate matters, it is highly likely they have a contact within the Knights of the Barracuda who is able to inform them of forthcoming raids, keeping the crew one step ahead of danger. Rather than stand idly by as more innocent Eorzeans die at the hands of the beast tribes' minions, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade has resolved to take matters into their own hands. Travel to the specified location and join Broken Blade Lieutenant War Wolf's unit in a planned ambush on the buccaneers.

The once-timid kobolds of O'Ghomoro have grown bold, their excursions taking them far from the mountains in which they live, and deep into thalassocratic territory in search of earth shards. However, an ancient treaty forged between the indigenous tribes and the first settlers of Vylbrand prevents the Knights of the Barracuda from intervention, even though reports of attacks on farmers living in areas rich in crystals increase with each new day. Rather than stand idly by as more innocent Eorzeans die at the hands of the beast tribes, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade has resolved to take action. Join Broken Blade Lieutenant War Wolf's unit on a mission to eradicate a kobold party sighted en route to a remote Lominsan settlement.

A band of delinquent sylphs calling themselves the “Dewflowers” are causing havoc in the Black Shroud by using their hypnotic lays to lure unsuspecting adventurers deep into the forest. Once the travelers are completely and utterly lost, the sylphs then appear before them and offer to lead them back to the main road...for a price. The Wood Wailers and the Gods' Quiver have both sent units into the forest to capture the rogue beastmen, but to no avail, and now the task of ridding the region of this menace has fallen to the Broken Blades. Join Lieutenant War Wolf at Camp Tranquil and help turn these tricksters to humus!

In their zealous pursuit of fire shards, kobold supplicants have crossed the border and are mining the territory of Limsa Lominsa. Apparently not content with plundering the earth, there have been recent reports of the impudent sappers raiding nearby settlements as well. Despite a lack of incriminating evidence, the exasperated Knights of the Barracuda have resolved to bring an end to the kobolds' antics through irregular channels─enter the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade! Join Broken Blade Lieutenant War Wolf's unit on their crusade to whack these troublesome moles.

The Qiqirn goon squad known as the “Deviled Eggs” has snuck into the royal hatcheries and made off with the delectable ovoid offspring of the rare golden dodo. Aside from depriving the sultana of her breakfast omelette, this audacious act of larceny has punctured the pride of her personal guard. Join Lieutenant War Wolf and his Broken Blades in their efforts to track down and silence the Deviled Eggs before the shame of palace security becomes common knowledge.

A Barracuda troopship sailing south through the Strait of Merlthor crossed paths with a buccaneer vessel affiliated with the Sahagin's Serpent Reavers. The pirates boarded the troopship and relieved it of its cargo─a shipment of imported flintlocks. Unwilling to compromise naval security by sending an entire squadron in pursuit of a single vessel, the Knights were forced to turn to the Broken Blades for assistance. Lieutenant War Wolf has tracked down the bilge-soaked brigands, and prepares to assault their hideout. Join him and his unit in the attack and retrieve the stolen shipment of flintlocks.

According to recent intelligence, an Amalj'aa army of unprecedented numbers has emerged from the south and pitched camp in Burnt Lizard Creek. The Brass Blades, charged with the defense of Ul'dah, have begun bolstering garrisons in the region's hamlets and reinforcing the siege walls in anticipation of an attack on the capital. The coin-grubbing Syndicate, however, has yet to lift sanctions on hiring mercenaries for fear that such warlike preparations will adversely affect trade. Thus it falls to the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade to blunt the advance of the encroaching threat and show the world how true warriors deal with invading curs. Join Lieutenant War Wolf at Camp Broken Water and assist his unit in their ambush of an Amalj'aa scouting party.

After breaking camp in Burnt Lizard Creek, several units of heavily armed Amalj'aa infantry have begun their slow march north to the Royal Sunway. There it is suspected they will turn west and advance to Ul'dah, destroying everything in their path, as is the cold-blooded beasts' wont. The sultanate dispatched a party of Brass Blades immediately upon hearing the news, but the trained guard were little match for the Amalj'aa and were all but eliminated─the few which did survive returning to tell spine-chilling tales of fearless warriors wielding terrible fire-breathing war machines. Rather than stand idly by as the Syndicate and their royal cat's-paw, the sultana, argue over what steps to take next, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade has pledged to take the sword to these foul invaders and send them and their unholy machina back to the pit from which they crawled. Join Lieutenant War Wolf at Camp Broken Water and assist his brothers in their planned assault.

Humbled in their conflict with the scalekin, the Ixal had retreated to lick their wounds for a time. Recently, however, there have been multiple reports of the feathered fiends raiding the lands of Ishgard for lumber. With the bulk of the Ishgard military committed to containing the scalekin, the Broken Blades have stepped in to clip the wings of the Ixali intruders and thereby curry favor with the crown prince. Join Lieutenant War Wolf at Camp Dragonhead and assist his unit in exterminating the Ixal.

Over the course of several moons, there have been frequent sightings of Ixali Battle Balloons in the skies of Ul'dah. Though the purpose for their intrusions has yet to be determined, the Syndicate has begun to entertain the unpleasant possibility that the heretofore hostile relations between the Amalj'aa and the Ixal have somehow developed into a military alliance. The Broken Blades have been tasked with locating one of these Battle Balloons, slaughtering the crew, and framing the massacre on the Amalj'aa. Join Lieutenant War Wolf at Camp Nine Ivies and assist his brothers in sowing discord among the enemies of the Syndicate.

The past moons have seen a significant rise in the number of armored caravans being laid to waste by some terrible, unidentified foe. According to intelligence gathered by agents of the Horn and Hand, most of the bodies found among the wreckage have been inflicted with a profuse number of bites, cuts, and burns akin to those found on victims of drake attacks. Some of the victims, however, exhibit bane-sores of a differing variety─these coming from what appears to be a blade. This has led us to believe that these unfortunate incidents are not merely random attacks by wild creatures, but precisely orchestrated assaults by the Amalj'aa to disrupt the flow of goods into Ul'dah. The sultanate's Brass Blades are doing what they can to ensure caravans have the protection they need when passing through the more dangerous areas of Thanalan, but a limited budget combined with the sheer size of the region has left the guard unable to perform their duty in a manner that could be deemed satisfactory. To convince the sultana and the Syndicate that the local guard requires more funding, the Brotherhood is seeking volunteers to join them in a mission to prove once and for all that the Amalj'aa are behind these attacks. All interested are to report to War Wolf in Camp Broken Water for details.

While Operation: Bloody Scales proved a success in bringing to light the involvement of the Amalj'aa in the recent string of caravan attacks, it was not enough to convince the tight-fisted Syndicate to allocate additional funds to the Brass Blades, and now the Brotherhood must take matters into their own hands to ensure the safety of the region. Upon closer inspection of the attack sites, Horn and Hand agents found several sets of ruts leading away from the carnage. Scouts later were able to track these marks back to a massive wheeled Amalj'aa fortress accompanied by a unit of drakes and their trainers. The scouts reported that not only were the drakes considerably larger than ones found in the wild, but that they were also branded with strange wards that seemed to amplify their already-violent nature. The Brotherhood of the Broken Blade cannot sit idly by while the Amalj'aa whet their appetites for blood on innocent souls, and is seeking recruits to ambush the fortress and eliminate the unit that travels with it. All those with the courage to accept this challenge are to report to Lieutenant War Wolf immediately.

Only through the strength and courage of our noble brothers and sisters was the Amalj'aa dreadnaught destroyed and its cold-blooded entourage put to the sword. Our fight, however, is far from over, for though the blood of many a beastman was spilled, the unforgivable creature known to have branded and trained the deadly drakes, Goldfang Adebb Chah, and his most fearsome creation, Zanig'oh, are still at large. To ensure that the drakemaster cannot spawn any more of his scaled killing machines and unleash them onto the realm, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade has made his assassination our top priority. Those who wish to etch their names into the annals of Brotherhood history are asked to join Lieutenant War Wolf in Camp Broken Water as we make our final move on Goldfang's last-known position.

Recently, there have been numerous reports of a pack of bloodthirsty wolves attacking farmsteads deep within the Black Shroud. According to eyewitness accounts, the pack is led by a ferocious alpha male with glowing red eyes, and the attacks have been conducted with a military-like precision unlike anything ever seen in the wild. Unfortunately, there are those within Stillglade Fane who believe that the wolves may be simply obeying the will of the forest, and thus it would be blasphemy to intervene. It is because of this internal bickering that the Holtwatch has been rendered unable to act on the pleas of those villagers who are obviously victims of something more than the “wood's wrath.” To make clear to the Fane the error in their judgment, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade is calling upon its loyal brothers and sisters to join in the patrolling of frequently attacked areas, not only to protect the lives of those living there, but also to determine once and for all who is truly behind these assaults.

As was expected, the pack attacking the villages was not feral, but an Ixal-trained unit of wolves specially bred for war. We have learned that Ixali bombardiers in their Battle Balloons will fly silently above the Shroud canopy until directly above their unsuspecting prey. They will then unleash the pack to ravage the surrounding area while the bombardiers raid the farmsteads' food and supply caches during the ensuing confusion. When the Ixal have gathered all that will fit in their balloons, they call off the pack and escape to the skies before anyone can divine what has happened. The Stillglade Fane has been informed of our findings, but bureaucracy is proving an even more imposing foe than the Ixal, and therefore once again, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade must act to bring peace to the region. All those eager to accompany our mission to eliminate the pack and the bombardiers controlling it, join Lieutenant War Wolf at the specified location for a briefing.

The Battle Balloon unit and its minions have been wiped out, but among the carnage remaining after the skirmish was no evidence of the alpha male, Deadeyes, or his trainer, Natali Xlotl the Howler. If these two are not found and slain, it is only a matter of time before a new pack of mindless killing machines is back in the forest terrorizing her people. To ensure this a future that never comes, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blades is calling for volunteers to venture into the forest and deal with the Howler and Deadeyes before the pair can escape the forest and slip back into Ixali territory.

Intelligence from allies in the Horn and Hand report that the Ixal have recently dispatched a scouting party lead by one Nazel Xlotl the Fleet into the Twelveswood to search for a new nesting location. To prevent the tribe from expanding their presence in the region, Brotherhood of the Broken Blade Lieutenant War Wolf is seeking able bodied men and women to hunt down the Ixali chief and slay him and his men before they succeed in taking a foothold in the sacred forest.

Their resources stretched thin by the recent invasion of the Garlean Empire into Mor Dhona, the Immortals are finding it difficult to adequately protect their supply caravans from a veritable blitzkrieg led by Amalj'aa strongman, Longtail Sebedd Gah. To ensure Grand Company weapons and provisions are safely delivered to the frontlines, the Immortal Flames have requested the assistance of the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade─known for their success in dealing with beast tribe threats. Those of the Brotherhood willing to lend their sword arms are to speak with Lieutenant War Wolf for operation details.

The Brotherhood of the Broken Blade has received reports that the kobold 59th Order Sapper Squad has ventured down from O'Ghomoro and into upper La Noscea in search of new mineral resources. However, an ancient treaty forged between the indigenous tribes and the first settlers of Vylbrand prevents the Maelstrom from intervention, even though reports of attacks on farmers living in areas rich in ore increase with each new day. Rather than stand idly by as more innocent Eorzeans die at the hands of the beast tribes, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade has resolved to take action. Join Broken Blade Lieutenant War Wolf's unit on a mission to eradicate the sappers and bring peace to the region.

Acting on intelligence received from Azeyma's Shields Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena regarding a newly discovered kobold garrison in Upper La Noscea, a Broken Blade unit was dispatched to infiltrate and destroy the camp. However, while the party was en route to the target location, it was ambushed by a band of cyclopes and lost three of its men before finally retreating back to Limsa Lominsa. Azeyma's Shields officials have currently joined with members of the Horn and Hand to determine the source of the false intelligence. In the meantime, the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade seeks payback for the lives of those lost in the line of duty, and is welcoming volunteers to join it in seeing those one-eyed bastards get what they deserve. Speak with Lieutenant War Wolf for further briefing.

According to intelligence gathered by agents of the Horn and Hand, international crime syndicate Zer'maat Five has hired the services of one “Xha Viqqoh the Nibbler” to infiltrate the upper levels of the Mizzenmast and assassinate the Admiral while she sleeps. Considering the number of guards on duty at the tower, this would normally be an impossible task. The Nibbler is rumored, however, to be a formidable mage with the ability to change her appearance into that of a tiny rat. Fortunately, the whereabouts of the shape-shifter's hideout have been discovered and the Shields are planning a covert mission to capture the criminal and foil her masters' plans. Join Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena immediately and assist her in her operation.

Rumor has that well-known songstress Palemoon Parazuzu, often seen performing in central Limsa Lominsa's Octant, is actually a lycanthropic assassin hired by the international crime syndicate Zer'maat Five to eliminate a high-ranking official in the Knights of the Barracuda. Azeyma's Shields' W'mhelgo Hena has been tracking Palemoon's movements for the past fortnight and believes she may have discovered a pattern. Join the Isleguard and assist her in capturing the shape-shifter before she can carry out her bloody mission.

A jolly mummer known around the realm for his traveling galago show, Rorogun the Tailtamer is loved by nobles and smallfolk alike. Newly gathered intelligence, however, suggests that the Lalafell actually is a member of the Zer'maat Five, using his pets in the smuggling and exchange of everything from forbidden artifacts and stolen relics to outlawed poisons and contraband. Azeyma's Shields has tracked Rorogun to Gridania, where he is currently conducting daily shows while practicing his foul trade. Join Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena in Tranquil Paths to ambush the mummer as he passes through the area on his way back to his campsite.

In an attempt to weaken the Zer'maat Five's grip on the realm, Azeyma's Shields has decided to assassinate the third ranking member of the Ul'dah branch of the underground organization, B'khenna the Phoenixfire. Known for her uncanny ability to survive any wound dealt her, no matter how grievous, B'khenna is a renowned gladiator, having won ten tourneys to date. She is also, however, a cold-blooded killer with strong connections to several high-standing members of Ul'dah's ruling class. Using the guise of one the Syndicate, Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena has succeeded in luring the swordswoman out to Nophica's Wells for a private meeting. There, in that remote corner of western Thanalan, the mission is to be carried out as discreetly as possible to avoid any unwanted attention. Join the Isleguard immediately and assist her in her operation.

n: Wanted: Ser Aucheforne of the High Tide
d: Recently, several well-guarded plantations privately owned by Gridania's Greatloam Growery were ravaged by an infestation of slugs, resulting in the loss of nearly one half of all this season's rye crop. Normally, such a disaster would be deemed an unfortunate but unavoidable act of nature, and soon forgotten, if not for the report of an Azeyma's Shields informant that claims a known member of the Zer'maat Five─Ser Aucheforne of the High Tide─was seen purchasing nearly all of Limsa Lominsa's remaining supplies of rye flour the same day the Growery's crops were destroyed, most likely intending to sell it back to the city at an inflated price once a flour shortage was imminent. The false knight must pay for his crimes, and has already been tracked to his hideout in Cassiopeia Hollow. Join Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena in the caves immediately and assist her in his capture.
tg: Ser Aucheforne of the High Tide

d: Godwin Goodgoat is known as a hardworking La Noscean shepherd. He raises his charges with grandfatherly attention, and their vibrant fleeces are highly sought after by merchants as a valuable export. Nevertheless, Azeyma's Shields has irrefutable evidence that this unassuming old man actually serves the Zer'maat Five as a frighteningly proficient weaponsmaster. An uncounted number of the Five's smugglers have used Godwin's fighting techniques to battle their way free of the law, and we cannot allow this training to continue. Join Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena and confront Godwin while he is taking his sheep out to pasture. But be warned: it is said the “dog” that helps herd his flock is a vicious and savage beast.

In an attempt to weaken the Zer'maat Five's grip on the realm, Azeyma's Shields has decided to assassinate B'khenna the Phoenixfire. B'khenna is notorious for the shrewd manner in which she manipulates people using both her public persona as a popular, retired gladiator, and her private persona as the merciless third-ranking member of the Five's underground organization. Despite having left the gladiatorial world thirty years ago, her appearance remains unaltered since her time in the arena. It is suspected that B'khenna maintains her looks with forbidden necromantic rites involving maggots. Be on guard. Join Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena in Camp Broken Water, follow orders, and douse the Phoenixfire.

If you visit the Acorn Orchard, you will find a man beloved by the children for the toys he crafts from wood. They call him the “Toymaker,” but his real name is Coiled Adder. He once earned fame as a gifted snake charmer, and is now a known agent of the Zer'maat Five. His identity was revealed when a child accidentally broke open one of his miniature wooden hand carts, and released a sundrake hatchling. The hatchling was stiff as a board, and appeared withered and dead, but on closer inspection, Seventh Eye Diego Athral realized that the drake had deliberately been placed in a death-like coma. If he so chose, Coiled Adder could have awakened the sundrake from outside the child's home with a whistle, and commanded it to steal information or even set fire to the house itself. Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena has been seducing Adder in the guise of an avid reptile enthusiast, and promised to meet him in an isolated location. Join the Isleguard and assist her in dispatching this slithering criminal.

Tales tell of an isle in the Far East where a talented band of spies have mastered the art of riding giant toads and seeing through the eyes of frogs. Recent intelligence states that one of these trained agents, Toadsquatter Femomo, has been hired at great expense by the Zer'maat Five. If the stories are true, Femomo could attempt to sneak a tiny dart frog into Azeyma's Shields headquarters and view all that transpired within. The identity of our members would be exposed, leaving them vulnerable to retaliation from underground elements. In a preemptive action, Toadsquatter has been lured to an unpopulated area where Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena awaits. Join the Isleguard, and assist in removing this threat.

All who visit the city of Gridania come away with at least one memory in common─the riot of colorful flowers adorning every household. The person maintaining these floral splendors is one Alvara Sourkiss, a dedicated gardener who visits each residence on a daily basis. An informant has accused the ever-smiling lass of growing poisonous herbs for the Zer'maat Five. While it is difficult to believe the sunny Alvara capable of such dastardly deeds, Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena is not one to be deceived by appearances. Join the Isleguard in her interrogation of the gardener, and assist in Sourkiss's demise should she attempt to resist.

Not long ago, Mathistien of the Cloven Hoof and his traveling grotesquery was one of the realm's most popular exhibitions. People would flock from all around the countryside to see such spectacles as the two-headed nannygoat, the hairless phurble, and the show's main attraction─the colossal Tarbh Uisge. However, it was not until after the giant creature broke loose from its fetters and trampled through Limsa Lominsa, starting a fire that destroyed hundreds of buildings and killed countless innocent citizens, including two high-ranking thalassocratic officials, that it was revealed that Mathistien was actually an assassin for the Zer'maat Five. Needless to say, the mummer was promptly arrested and exiled to a lonely island prison in the Cieldalaes, where he has remained in solitude for the past ten years...or so we thought, for lately there have been rumors that the assassin has fled his island prison and is not only back on Vylbrand, but has brought with him his loyal pet, Tarbh Uisge. Azeyma's Shields is certain that this is the work of the Zer'maat Five, and will stop at nothing to recapture this dangerous criminal and bring him back to justice, but first we require evidence that he is actually in the region. A party to do just that is currently gathering in Bloodshore, and all volunteers are welcome.

Our search for evidence pointing to Mathistien of the Cloven Hoof's return to Vylbrand turned up several abnormally large pieces of dung, which were determined by naturalists to have only been produced by a creature at least twenty times as large as an aldgoat. In addition, within the faeces was found a large quantity of young roseling leaves, which are known to be Tarbh Uisge's preferred forage, leading us to believe that the terrible beast has been brought onto the island. To capture the creature (and whoever is controlling it), a trap needs to be set, and what a better way to capture a giant buffalo with an affinity for roseling leaves than with a giant bushel of the heavenly herbage? Volunteers are required to assist Isleguards W'mhelgo Hena and Koppo Aroppo in collecting the leaves and are asked to hurry to Bloodshore as soon as possible to begin the search.

Tarbh Uisge and its devilish master, Mathistien of the Cloven Hoof, can be allowed to roam the peaceful meadows of La Noscea no longer. Preparations have been made to lure the giant beast out of hiding with a scrumptious salad made from tender young roseling leaves, and now Azeyma's Shields seeks brave warriors from across the realm to join hands in subduing the creature once it has lumbered out of hiding and taken the bait. Those interested are to report to Isleguards W'mhelgo Hena and Koppo Aroppo in Bloodshore immediately. There is no time to lose!

Not more than a few days past, a forerunner en route to a Maelstrom outpost in eastern La Noscea was attacked by a small party of unidentifiable creatures, and the pack he carried taken. This pack contained a rare magic tome that was to be delivered to Grand Company arcanists stationed at the outpost who would decipher the ancient text and add the knowledge to the thalassocracy's arsenal. If these spells documented within that tome were to fall into the wrong hands, it could seriously compromise city-state security and put the lives of thousands in danger. Azeyma's Shields have good reason to believe that this theft may be the work of Zer'maat Five underling Ursulien the Unseen, and Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena is seeking volunteers to hunt down the criminal a reclaim the missing relic.

Though successful in capturing Zer'maat Five assassin Wawameri Whiteeyes, Azeyma's Shields operatives were unable to subdue his faithful familiar Princess Pudding. Left to roam free the realm, this voidsent could prove extremely dangerous, and therefore the faction has made finding and slaying the creature our top priority. Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena has vital information on where Princess Pudding was last spotted and is seeking volunteers to assist in completing this deadly mission.

A party of historians searching for the ruins of Nym─a civilization that prospered on Vylbrand during the Fifth Astral Era─has recently found itself the victim of brutal attacks waged by a small group of bandits and their pet coeurl. Horn and Hand intelligence suggests that the culprits can be none other than an infamous gang known as Striped Lightning, and to bring these dastards to justice, Azeyma's Shields is offering a bountiful reward to any who can assist in their capture. Speak with Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena for further details.

While searching for ore deposits in Coerthas, a group of miners dispatched by Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern were ambushed by a ferocious ogre. According to those who were fortunate enough to escape, the voidsent destroyed their equipment, ate their chocobos, and ripped apart any man it could get its hands on. Based on the description given by the survivors, Azeyma's Shields believe this ogre to be Porus─a savage, bloodthirsty beast known to show little mercy to its victims as it rends them limb from limb and devours them in a single bite. Isleguard W'mhelgo Hena is currently seeking volunteers to join in locating and slaying this menace to the realm.

After learning that false intelligence from their own faction led to the death of three members of the Brotherhood of the Broken Blade, Isleguards W'mhelgo Hena and Koppo Aroppo have started an internal investigation to determine its source. Those interested in assisting our faction in subduing the mole are to head to Upper La Noscea and speak with Koppo Aroppo immediately.

Several nights alone in the Coral Tower brig have finally loosened Maskmaker V'dhoramo's tongue and she has begun to paint a vivid picture of what drove her to treachery and treason. For the past several moons, the crafty Seeker of the Sun has been working for none other than the Garlean Empire, feeding false intelligence to Eorzea's Adventurers' Guild in order to weaken the realm's military strength by slowly incapacitating its many sellswords. While nothing can be done to reverse the damage already done, the Adventurers' Guild is not about to sit idly by and forget all that has happened. The Guild has approached Azeyma's Shields with a plan for swift retribution─using the captured prisoner to summon her Garlean contacts out of hiding...only this time, you will be waiting for them. Those interested in participating in this important mission are to speak with Isleguard Koppo Aroppo in Upper La Noscea.

Limsa Lominsa is astir with speculation over the mysterious wooden boxes that recently washed into port. After obtaining one of these tightly sealed crates for our faction, we opened it to discover a number of large, bullet-shaped hunks of metal packed in sawdust. Upon closer inspection, we deduced that the oversized bullets were actually cannon shells expertly forged from incredibly light mythril─apparently a shipment of foreign ammunition has found its way to our shores. We ask for volunteers to collect as many of these crates as possible so that we might safely dismantle the contents and prevent any accidental explosions from mishandling this unfamiliar ordnance.

The region's current midge infestation has become more than a nuisance, now threatening the crops and livestock of many the farmers and shepherds who work the fields of La Noscea. After numerous petitions to the Admiral, the city-state has decided to take action, working in conjunction with several of the hardest-hit guilds to eliminate the pest problem by hiring adventurers to seek out and exterminate the insects. Why fight dangerous vilekin, though, when eliminating the creatures' eggs before they hatch could achieve the same results, as well as improve our faction's standing with the Admiral herself (while earning us a large portion of the allotted bounty)? Travel to the indicated location and assist Seventh Eye Diego Athral in the collection of soil samples to determine where the midges are laying their eggs. Based on the findings, another party will be sent to “purify” the land.

Last night, a caravan commissioned by the Lancaster family to deliver a shipment of archaeological artifacts was attacked by a band of highwaymen outside Limsa Lominsa. Among the items stolen were hundreds of samples of rare bronze coins minted in the 3rd Astral Era by the lost Allagan Empire. To the untrained eyes of the brigands, however, the coins must have seemed little more than pieces of rusted rubbish, for there is a trail of discarded items leading away from the site of the assault. To improve our faction's standing with the well-endowed Lancasters, we ask for volunteers to travel to the wreckage and assist in recovering the coins before the highwaymen realize their mistake and return to retrieve the items themselves.

An entire shelf-load of flasks was recently stolen from Frondale's Phrontistery. The culprit, a disreputable Dunesfolk chap, was soon arrested as he was discovered struggling in mid-air by the city gate, his belly swollen up like an Ixali Battle Balloon. The unfortunate thief had mistaken the experimental flotation liquid for growth potions. Although the case is officially closed, there remains a significant problem─the emptied flasks strewn about the city. If even a single drop of the unstable chemical should remain, it will gradually react to the oxygen in the air and almost certainly explode. It falls to the Horn and Hand to gather these ticking time bombs and rescue fair Ul'dah from imminent catastrophe.

Goblin-made “sweetboxes” have been placed around Gridania to repel the voracious insects that feed on the city greenery. Unfortunately, the sickly-sweet fumes escaping from the boxes also have the effect of driving away the benign bugs necessary for pollination, not to mention inducing nausea and dizziness in small children. We ask for volunteers to quickly and quietly remove these malodorous inventions and help us ensure the well-being of Gridania's citizenry.

A caravan loaded with goods was traveling along the trade route between Limsa Lominsa and Ishgard until it was decimated in Coerthas by an Ixali raiding party. The caravan's goods were assured by Triton's Marine Assurance, so naturally the company would prefer to attempt to recover some of the cargo rather than replace it completely. We can assume that the Ixal carried away the majority of the items, but they are known to care little for heavy armor. This is our chance to enter Triton's good graces. Travel to the scene of the attack and see if any of the trunks of armor can be salvaged.

The notorious Qiqirn burglar Longnose Gnognoroon will finally be released from prison after serving a ten-year sentence. For the short-lived Qiqirn race, ten years is the equivalent of half a lifetime. Among the many valuables Gnognoroon is thought to have stolen, there is a certain treasure that was never recovered─the “Shiva's Tear” diamond. It is assumed that upon his release, the now-venerable Qiqirn will waste no time in digging up the precious stone so that he may spend his dotage in decadent comfort. Travel to the indicated location and relieve Seventh Eye Diego Athral from his duty. Follow Gnognoroon without being detected, and discover where the Shiva's Tear is hidden.

There is a rumor circulating among the miners that the spriggans of Coerthas have struck a sizeable vein of gold ore. Should this prove true, and the Horn and Hand is able to capitalize on their good fortune, our faction shall escape the rising waters of debt threatening to drown us. Travel to the indicated location, relieve Seventh Eye Diego Athral from his duty, and follow one of the spriggans without being detected. Our financial freedom hinges on discerning where the monstrous miners stash their precious metal!

Among the antling hierarchy, there are the worker ants, responsible for gathering food, and the soldier ants, tasked with defending the colony. The ratio of workers to soldiers is strictly controlled by the type of eggs laid by the queen, and all the myriad members of the colony function together as a single organism. Far more cohesive than even the most disciplined army, the antlings are seen by Ul'dah as a looming danger that must be contained. Thus the question was posed: what if we were able to control the type of antling that hatched from an egg? Too few workers, and the colony would starve. Too few soldiers, and the queen would be defenseless. Further research into this idea requires a large number of samples. Travel to the indicated location and assist Seventh Eye Diego Athral in gathering antling eggs.

Shortly after departing Millers' Glade in the Coerthas eastern lowlands, an airship carrying supplies to Gridania was attacked by a pair of dragons. Knowing that they did not have the firepower to dispatch the creatures, the pilot chose instead to outrun them. To do so, however, he gave the order to jettison several items in his cargo hold in order to lighten the airship, thus increasing its speed. Cheers of joy filled the vessel when it arrived safely in the Black Shroud, but when the pilot realized which cargo was abandoned, those cheers soon turned to shouts of anger, for the crates that were lost were owned by one of the wealthiest noble families in Ishgard. The Horn and Hand has determined this a most opportune chance to improve our faction's standing in the mountain city-state, and so we seek volunteers to travel to the wreckage and assist in recovering the crates before bandits come across the items and claim them for themselves.

For use on a forthcoming mission, the Horn and Hand requires several clumps of a rare moss known as “virgin's veil.” Only found in remote locations of the Black Shroud, virgin's veil has a remarkably short lifespan, producing spores mere bells from its sprouting, only to wither and die before the next day's evenfall. Unfortunately, it is this unique characteristic that makes the moss, prized for its deodorizing qualities, extremely difficult to obtain. Our trusted agent, Diego Athral, has been dispatched to a location rumored to recently have seen abundant growth of the moss, and is seeking loyal volunteers to assist him in gathering the fleeting plant. All interested are to report to the Seventh Eye immediately.

For use on a forthcoming mission, the Horn and Hand requires a large quantity of rainbow flies. This elusive vilekin, however, is rarely ever seen by man, due to a combination of a prism-like chitinous body and the mind-boggling speed at which the creature cuts through the air. Currently, the only reliable method known to subdue a rainbow fly is to let the fly's only natural predator─the butcher basilisk─do the work for you. Rather than relying on its underdeveloped eyes to see the nearly invisible vilekin, the butcher basilisk utilizes its highly developed olfactory nerves to track the fly's movement and predict its flight pattern. Once its prey is caught, the basilisk will then carry it to a thorned tree or sharp rock, where it will impale the rainbow fly and leave the twitching carcass to attract female butcher basilisks.   Volunteers are sought to track a butcher basilisk until it catches a rainbow fly, wait until the fly has been impaled, and then collect the fly before a female basilisk arrives. The same sense of smell that allows the butcher basilisk to detect the scent of rainbow flies will also alert it of a person's presence, causing the beast to run and hide. To ensure the volunteers do not attract the unwanted attention of the scalekin, we will provide a special deodorizing agent made from virgin's veil to mask all unpleasant odors.

After moons of investigation, it has been determined that a ruthless band of poachers known as the Antlions is responsible for the death of hundreds of rare white antelopes─revered by Gridanians as holy messengers of the wood. While several of the bandits have been captured and jailed by the local Holtwatch, it is believed that as long as the band's ringleader, Hooknosed Wylla, is still at large, the rampant poaching will continue. Unfortunately, city-state law will not allow her arrest without conclusive evidence that she was truly involved in the killing of white antelopes. To gather this evidence, the Horn and Hand is seeking brave volunteers to join Seventh Eye Diego Athral in the tracking of Hooknosed Wylla. Those participating in the mission will be rationed a special concoction made from the chitin of rainbow flies. This “prism powder” will render its wearers invisible, allowing them to safely track Wylla until she leaves behind an item that might implicate her in her crimes.

Recently, the Adventurers' Guild has discovered several cases of guild reports being stolen or tampered with. Faulty intelligence from these reports has resulted in numerous accidents, the most severe being the ambush of a Brotherhood of the Broken Blade unit and the death of three of its members. The Adventurers' Guild, worried that this may be the work of someone on the inside, has petitioned the Horn and Hand to discover the culprit. The faction, in turn, seeks volunteers to aid in the deductive process. All interested are to speak with Seventh Eye Diego Athral already collecting clues in Upper La Noscea.

Drowning Wench proprietor Baderon Tenfingers requires flint stones for the tinder boxes he sells to the adventurers who frequent his alehouse. According to Baderon, suitable samples can be obtained from the various outcroppings located near Camp Bearded Rock.

In an attempt to document locations in La Noscea housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Bearded Rock and search for viable mineral deposits.

The Knights of the Barracuda have petitioned Naldiq & Vymelli's to craft hundreds of medals to present to the survivors of a recent naval victory against the Sahagin. To manufacture the sheer number of items the navy has ordered, the guild requires a large quantity of metal-rich ore from the veins located in the hills near Camp Bearded Rock.

In an attempt to document locations in La Noscea housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Skull Valley and search for viable mineral deposits.

The Knights of the Barracuda have petitioned Naldiq & Vymelli's to develop a new model of flintlock for use in their marine levies. To manufacture the sheer number of weapons the navy has ordered, the guild requires a large quantity of metal-rich ore from the veins located in the hills near Camp Skull Valley.
In an attempt to document locations in La Noscea housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Bloodshore and search for viable mineral deposits.

The Knights of the Barracuda have petitioned Naldiq & Vymelli's to forge several hundred decorative cutlasses for use by their marine officers. To manufacture the sheer number of weapons the navy has ordered, the guild requires a large quantity of metal-rich ore from the veins located in the hills near Camp Bloodshore.

In its ongoing efforts to record viable mining locations across the realm, Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern is seeking able-bodied miners to assist it in the assaying of rocky outcroppings in Cedarwood. All those interested are asked to report to the area's aetherial gate before taking up the search.

To coincide with the promotion of several seamen to the rank of officer, the Knights of the Barracuda has promised a sizeable order with Naldiq & Vymelli's for the creation of decorative muskets to be presented to the new officers at their induction ceremony. In anticipation of the order, the Blacksmiths' Guild is hiring skilled miners to assist it in replenishing its dwindling supplies of the superior-quality iron ore most commonly found in the Cedarwood area.

Decades after establishing presence in the remote area known as Iron Lake, Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern is worried that over-mining may be leading to a rapid depletion of available resources. In an effort to assess the current viability of the area's rocky outcroppings, the Miners' Guild is actively seeking skilled pick-men and women to travel to Camp Iron Lake and collect sample data from several popular mining points.

The Drowning Wench's supply of O'Ghomorran mead is near exhaustion and proprietor Baderon Tenfingers requires a large quantity of wildflower honey to create a new batch. According to Baderon, suitable bee hives can be found in abundance in trees near Camp Bearded Rock.

Continuing in their efforts to document the locations of prime sources of high-quality wood, the Botanists' Guild in Gridania is hiring adventurers to gather timber samples from the area around Camp Bearded Rock.

A trading company from the Far East has hired the shipwrights of Naldiq & Vymelli's to build a small fleet of galleons...and no expense is to be spared. To complete the project on time, the guild requires a large quantity of La Noscean teak lumber, which can be found growing in the plains near Camp Bearded Rock.

To complete the project on time, the guild requires a large quantity of coastal oak lumber, which can be found growing in the plains near Camp Skull Valley.

Numerous reports of dead, withered-up trees in Bloodshore have Botanists' Guild officials concerned that a blight has infected the area's foliage. To determine if the reports are merely isolated cases or the onset of an epidemic, the Greatloam Growery is seeking skilled adventurers to travel to eastern La Noscea and gather data on several random logging points.

To increase the thalassocracy's hold on the Rhotano Sea and its islands, the Admiral has placed an order with Naldiq & Vymelli's for a new fleet of mid-sized galleys. To ensure the prompt fulfillment of this massive order, the Armorers' Guild is hiring skilled botanists to travel to Bloodshore and procure the walnut logs that will be used in crafting the ships' sidings.

For centuries, the shipbuilders of Limsa Lominsa have relied on the abundant timber harvested from the hills of Cedarwood to construct their seaworthy masterpieces. However, the years of mass deforestation have finally begun to take their toll─the area's once-lush forest reduced to a few scattered sentinels standing vigil in a sea of grass and shrubbery. In a bold attempt to return Cedarwood to its former glory, the Botanists' Guild has contrived a plan to reforest the area, but to accomplish this, it first requires volunteers to locate viable logging points and from them collect several cuttings of the remaining trees, which it will grow under guild supervision until they have reached a size when they can be replanted.

To increase the thalassocracy's hold on the Rhotano Sea and its islands, the Admiral has placed an order with Naldiq & Vymelli's for a new fleet of mid-sized galleys. To ensure the prompt fulfillment of this massive order, the Armorers' Guild is hiring skilled botanists to travel to Cedarwood and procure the mahogany logs that will be used in outfitting the captain's quarters in each ship.

Continuing in their efforts to document the locations of prime sources of high-quality wood, the Botanists' Guild in Gridania is hiring adventurers to gather timber samples from the area around Camp Iron Lake.

A trading company from the Far East has hired the shipwrights of Naldiq & Vymelli's to build a small fleet of galleons...and no expense is to be spared. To complete the project on time, the guild requires a large quantity of coastal spruce lumber, which can be found growing in the plains near Camp Iron Lake.

To accommodate those patrons who require more sustenance than a flagon of warm ale, Drowning Wench proprietor Baderon Tenfingers also offers some of the best smoked herring in the region, prepared right outside the alehouse early every morning before cockcall. Since he cannot well leave the Wench to procure the fish himself, Baderon will pay handsomely for any fresh herring, but only that which was caught from the seas adjacent Bearded Rock.

In an attempt to document the habitats and migration patterns of different varieties of marine life in the area, the Limsa Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the coastal cliffs near Camp Bearded Rock and test the waters.

Spurred by rumors of remarkably enhanced virility by those who consumed them, the sale of raw oysters in Limsa Lominsa's Bismarck has taken an unexpected upturn. To meet the overwhelming demand, the restaurant is petitioning properly equipped fishermen and women to travel to the cliffs off Bearded Rock and muster as many of the mollusks as they can find.

In an attempt to document the habitats and migration patterns of different varieties of marine life in the area, the Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the coastal cliffs near Camp Skull Valley and test the waters.

When the trading vessel Moonbeam returned from a journey to the Far East, her crew brought back with them tales of a strange people who defied death by consuming the raw flesh of the poisonous blowfish. Refusing to be shown up by “foreign savages,” pirates and toughs from all across the city have taken to testing their own courage by braving the deadly dish. Normally avoided by the local pullers and thus difficult to find in the city markets, the Bismarck is offering good coin to those fishers who would bring them fresh catch.

In an effort to document migration patterns of sea life native to the coastal waters of La Noscea, the Fishermen's Guild is seeking adventurers to fish the cliffs of Bloodshore and report any relevant findings. All interested are to convene at the area's aetheryte camp, equipped with rod and bait.

As he does once every moon, Ishgardian noble Duke Brett V will soon be arriving in Limsa Lominsa to conduct a routine inspection of the many export and import warehouses he maintains in the thalassocracy. And, as always, he has requested the Bismarck to prepare three servings of his favorite dish, braised bream with aurelia cream sauce, for each day of his one-week stay. To ensure the timely completion of this unorthodox order, the Culinarians' Guild is seeking adventurers to travel to Bloodshore and procure several of the extra plump Bianaq bream that the duke craves.

In an attempt to document the habitats and migration patterns of different varieties of marine life in the area, the Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the coastal cliffs near Cedarwood and test the waters.

A new creation by renowned chef Pulmia─tender roast lobster tail drowned in a wine and mushroom sauce─has patrons lining up to sample the delicacy. To meet the demand, the Bismarck requires as many fresh lobsters as can be obtained, and is willing to handsomely reward any who can meet the task.

Iron Lake is said to get its name from the high concentration of iron found in its waters. While such poisoning would normally render a body of water unfit to sustain life, Iron Lake is a veritable paradise for a wide variety of fish, crustaceans, and other freshwater wavekin. To better understand this phenomenon, the Fishermen's Guild of Limsa Lominsa is offering good coin to skilled fishers willing to travel to the remote area, cast their lines in several locations, and report to the guild any data they find upon completion of the quest.

A well-fed marine is a happy marine, or so says Thalassocratic Navy First Squadron, Second Levy Infantry, Yellowjacket Sergeant Sylskaetsyn, and so he makes sure that on the first sun of every moon, his marines are treated to a bowl of the Bismarck's savoriest of soups─carp bisque. To feed the hundreds of hungry servicemen under his command, however, a plethora of plump maiden carp from the sparkling waters of Iron Lake are required, forcing the Culinarians' Guild to seek out adventurers who are willing to brave the wilds and bring basketfuls of tasty fish back to the restaurant.

As a gesture of kindness, Quicksand proprietress Momodi provides many of her new patrons with an adventuring kit containing several useful items, including flint stones. The recent influx of adventurers, however, has caused her supplies to dwindle, and now she seeks volunteers willing to journey to Black Brush and gather her some of the stones.
In an attempt to document locations in Thanalan housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Black Brush and search for viable mineral deposits.

To meet the ever-changing needs of their fashion-conscious clientele, Eshtaime's Aesthetics is always in the market for high-quality ores and raw, uncut gems. This season, jewelry featuring the deep red tones of copper ore only found in Black Brush is in high demand, and the guild is willing to pay a premium for samples delivered.
In an attempt to document locations in Thanalan housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Drybone and search for viable mineral deposits.

This season, wristlets and brooches made from the smoky grey silver found only in the rocky terrain of Drybone are popular amongst Ul'dah's ruling class, and the guild is willing to pay a premium for samples delivered.

In an effort to assess the current viability of the area's rocky outcroppings, the Miners' Guild is actively seeking skilled miners to travel to Camp Horizon and collect sample data from several popular mining points.

Baubles and trinkets containing lustrous sphenes have become highly sought-after items amongst the upper class wives in Ul'dah, leaving Eshtaime's Aesthetics scrambling to restock their vaults with the semi-precious stone. The guild is offering fair recompense to any adventurers willing and able to travel to Horizon's Edge and excavate the gems from the area's mineral-rich foothills and mesas.

In an attempt to document locations in Thanalan housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Nophica's Wells and search for viable mineral deposits.

To meet the ever-changing needs of their fashion-conscious clientele, Eshtaime's Aesthetics is always in the market for high-quality ores and raw, uncut gems. This season, hairpins made from the remarkably lightweight mythril found only in the rocky terrain of Horizon's Edge and Nophica's Wells are popular among the unwed daughters of Ul'dahn merchants, and the guild is willing to pay a premium for samples delivered.

All those interested are asked to report to the area's aetherial gate before taking up the search.

For the sultana's forthcoming nameday ceremony, the royal court has petitioned Eshtaime's Aesthetics to create a magnificent cloak woven solely from unblemished heliodor stones. To complete the order, the Goldsmiths' Guild requires several hundred more of the yellow gems, and is hiring adventurers to travel to Halatali and excavate the requested item.

Known for its rich, sweet flavor and its less-than-subtle kick, the Quicksand's homemade honey wine is sought out by all who visit the sultanate's capital city. To ensure that her barrels do not run dry, pub proprietress Momodi requires a constant supply of fresh honey, and will pay good coin to those who would bring her back several of the bee hives found on the parched plains of Black Brush.

Continuing in their efforts to document the locations of prime sources of high-quality wood, the Botanists' Guild in Gridania is hiring adventurers to gather timber samples from the area around Camp Black Brush.

Corrosive gasses, acidic guano, and hungry termites are only a few of the forces that slowly eat away at the wooden pillars that support the numerous shafts in each and every one of Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern's company-run mines. To prevent devastating cave-ins─which would stop the flow of ore, bringing financial ruin to the guild (and possibly trap miners)─the Concern has put out the call to eager botanists looking to earn good coin in exchange for a few high-quality willow logs harvested from Black Brush.

A pair of archaeologists studying the history surrounding the ancient Lalafell ruins at Halatali have petitioned the Botanists' Guild to assist them in dating several trees that appear to have been marked by the tribes who once worshipped in the area. Due to the remote location and relative danger, the guild is wary to send its own men and women to find promising logging points where the tests will be conducted, and therefore is seeking able-bodied adventurers to take up the task.

Sitting behind a desk, deep beneath a mountain of rock, poring over progress reports and production estimates can take its toll on the average Amajina & Sons pit overseer, which is why the Concern makes it its first concern to see that the overseer is treated like a sultan. One of the ways that the guild accomplishes this is by ensuring that his office is constantly equipped with only the finest aldgoat parchment, aurelia ink, and Halatali mahogany furnishings. Good Halatali mahogany, however, is hard to come by, and so Amajina and her sons are constantly seeking out talented botanists to travel to the sacred mesas and harvest the rare timber.

With all the effort spent slaying deadly dragons and saving distressed damsels, today's active adventurer does not always have the time for a healthy meal. Quicksand proprietress Momodi knows it is hard to juggle all the tasks adventurers must face, but she also knows the importance of breaking one's fast before breaking some heads, and that is why she always keeps her larders filled with nutrient-packed salt carp. Whether eaten in the tavern with a tall flagon of ale, or in the wilds under starry skies, salt carp can give an adventurer that extra boost he needs to fight evil and uphold justice in the realm. And to make sure Momodi never must turn away a paying customer, she will generously reward any who would be willing to sell her some fresh fish from the pools in Black Brush.

In an attempt to document the habitats of different varieties of desert wavekin in the area, the Limsa Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the cenotes near Camp Black Brush, fish the waters, and report to the guild their findings.

After moons of research, Frondale's Phrontistery leeches have discovered that the shell of a certain species of freshwater crayfish contains a substance that, when mixed with wine and the root of the mandrake, cures greyscale. The Phrontistery wishes to begin mass production of the tincture immediately, and requires large quantities of bigclaw crayfish from the cenotes near Camp Black Brush.

In an attempt to document the habitats of different varieties of desert wavekin in the area, the Limsa Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the cenotes near Camp Drybone, fish the waters, and report to the guild their findings.

The Phrontistery wishes to begin mass production of the tincture immediately, and requires large quantities of bitterbite pipira from the cenotes near Camp Drybone.

In an attempt to document the habitats of different varieties of desert wavekin in the area, the Limsa Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the cenotes in and around Halatali, fish the waters, and report to the guild their findings.

The Phrontistery wishes to begin mass production of the tincture immediately, and requires large quantities of jade marimo from the cenotes near Camp Halatali.

In an effort to document the many freshwater species living in the cenotes of western Thanalan, the Fishermen's Guild is seeking adventurers to fish several of the deep pools found in the remote area known as Nophica's Wells and report any relevant findings. All interested are to convene at the area's aetherial gate, equipped with rod and bait.

Over the past moons, several fishermen have died while fishing near Nophica's Wells. After thorough autopsies on the corpses, it was determined that each one had succumbed to the poison of the deadly monke onke. To learn more of the wavekin's venom and ultimately use that knowledge to synthesize an antidote, researchers at Frondale's Phrontistery are seeking adventurers to travel to western Thanalan and catch samples of the ferocious fish.

Unlike species found in other regions, the wavekin living in the parched deserts of Thanalan have somehow managed to thrive in conditions far harsher than those faced by their cousins. To better understand how this is possible, the Fishermen's Guild is actively seeking able-bodied fishers to study the waterholes and creeks located in Horizon's Edge. Those interested are to gather their rods and bait and report immediately to the area's aetheryte camp.

The black ghost's unique ability to maintain and emit a lightning-based elemental charge has long confounded the scientists of Frondale's Phrontistery. A recent order from the Syndicate, however, to develop a handheld weapon built on those principles has the Alchemists' Guild scrambling to unlock the wavekin's electrifying secret before funding is cut off. To complete its research, the guild is offering a hefty reward for fresh black ghost specimens harvested from the acrid waters found about Horizon's Edge.

To equip the tinder boxes she sells to the adventurers who frequent her establishment, the proprietress of the Carline Canopy is always willing to pay good coin for flint stones dug from the outcroppings surrounding Camp Bentbranch.

In an attempt to document locations in the Black Shroud housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Camp Bentbranch and search for viable mineral deposits in the outlying forest.
To meet an urgent order placed by the Holtwatch for two score hundred newly crafted arrows, the Centaur's Eye requires several pieces of high-quality bone from Bentbranch.

Reports of zombie-like creatures roaming the Twelveswood have local citizens on edge. Though lacking any concrete evidence that undead souls truly have begun to run amok, the Centaur's Eye does not want to take any unwanted chances, and is therefore preparing to craft a large cache of silver arrowheads that can be easily attached to existing shafts in the event that an outbreak does occur. To do this, it requires a large supply of high-quality silver ore and is seeking skilled miners to travel to Tranquil Paths and excavate the precious metal from the rocky outcrops scattered about the area.

Rumors of ore-rich outcroppings in Humblehearth have piqued the interest of Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern representatives, but before investing a large sum of gil in setting up operations in the area, the guild requires more data on the viability of the mining points. To collect this data, the Miners' Guild is offering good coin to local adventurers willing to dig at several locations within Humblehearth.
To meet an urgent order placed by the Holtwatch for three score hundred newly crafted arrowheads, the Centaur's Eye requires several chunks of high-quality raw jade from Humblehearth.

In an attempt to document locations in the Black Shroud housing veins of precious ore, the Miners' Guild in Ul'dah is petitioning adventurers to journey to Treespeak and search for viable mineral deposits.
To meet an urgent order placed by the Holtwatch for two score hundred newly crafted arrows, the Centaur's Eye requires several chunks of high-quality obsidian from Treespeak.

Carline Canopy honey tea is one of the most popular items on the inn's menu; honey, however, is in short supply, and the Canopy's proprietress will generously reward anyone who brings her honeybee hives from Bentbranch.

Continuing in their efforts to document the locations of prime sources of high-quality wood, the Botanists' Guild in Gridania is hiring adventurers to gather timber samples from the area around Camp Bentbranch.

A great storm has damaged many of the waterwheels used to power the mills that grind Gridania's supplies of sunset wheat and millioncorn. The Oak Atrium is working to repair the wheels, but requires several unknotted elm logs from Bentbranch to complete the task.

Continuing in their efforts to document the locations of prime sources of high-quality wood, the Botanists' Guild in Gridania is hiring adventurers to gather timber samples from the area around Camp Emerald Moss.

A well-endowed miller in Gridania wishes to expand, and has petitioned the Oak Atrium to build him a waterwheel for a new mill he is planning on the Black Tea River. To complete the task, the guild requires several unknotted walnut logs from Emerald Moss, and will pay good coin for them.

Continuing in their efforts to document the locations of prime sources of high-quality wood, the Botanists' Guild in Gridania is hiring adventurers to gather timber samples from the area around Camp Tranquil.

Years of wear have left the blades on one of Gridania's most famous waterwheels─Cutter's Heart─rotten and eroded, prompting the city-state to petition the Oak Atrium to craft a set of new blades. To meet this order, the Carpenters' Guild is seeking skilled botanists to travel to Tranquil Paths and procure high-quality oak logs from select trees in the area.

Continuing in their efforts to document the locations of prime sources of high-quality wood, the Botanists' Guild in Gridania is hiring adventurers to gather timber samples from the area around Humblehearth.

After fifty years of service, the waterwheel at old Hostein's mill has finally rotted to the point it can turn no more. To repair the giant wheel, the Oak Atrium requires several logs of unknotted mahogany from Humblehearth.

Numerous reports of dead, withered-up trees in Treespeak have Botanists' Guild officials concerned that a blight has infected the area's foliage. To determine if the reports are merely isolated cases or the onset of an epidemic, the Greatloam Growery is seeking skilled adventurers to travel to the North Forest and gather data on several random logging points.

A well-to-do family in Ishgard has placed an order with the Oak Atrium for a full set of furnishings for their new winter home in the Cieldalaes. Unfortunately, due to a termite infestation in its warehouse, the Carpenters' Guild currently lacks a sufficient amount of high-quality rosewood to finish the order, and seeks skilled botanists to travel to Treespeak and procure the rare material.

To ensure her larders stay well-stocked during the meager moons ahead, the Carline Canopy proprietress requires several fresh salmon, which she will dry and preserve. She will, however, only accept salmon fished from the waters near Bentbranch.

In an attempt to document the habitats of different varieties of forest-dwelling wavekin in the area, the Limsa Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the cenotes near Camp Bentbranch, fish the waters, and report to the guild their findings.

To make the plaza near the Knot more sightly, the proprietor of the Roost wishes to increase the number of fish on display in the many aquariums. He will pay good coin to any fishers who can catch him rare bone crayfish from the waters near Camp Bentbranch.

In an attempt to document the habitats of different varieties of forest-dwelling wavekin in the area, the Limsa Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the cenotes near Camp Emerald Moss, fish the waters, and report to the guild their findings.

To make the plaza near the Knot more sightly, the proprietress of the Roost wishes to increase the number of fish on display in the many aquariums. She will pay good coin to any fishers who can catch her Gridanian fighting fish from the waters near Camp Emerald Moss.

In an effort to document the various species of wavekin native to the rivers and lakes of the Black Shroud, the Fishermen's Guild is seeking adventurers to fish several locations within Nine Ivies and report any relevant findings. All interested are to convene at the area's aetheryte camp equipped with rod and bait.

The Roost has been serving its realm-famous fried pike to hungry patrons for more than five generations, thanks to the helping hands of local fishers who provide the establishment with fresh northern pike from the lakes and rivers in Nine Ivies. To ensure the tradition lives on, Mother Miounne is always searching for adventurers to help in the procurement of the fish, and will handsomely reward all who do.

A recent, sudden drop in the number of fish caught in and around Humblehearth has the Fishermen's Guild worried that overfishing may be having an adverse effect on the area's delicate ecosystem. To better assess current fish populations, the guild is hiring adventurers to travel to Humblehearth and fish several select locations.

A newly founded, second-rate eatery known as the Floundering Fish has begun buying up all Gridania's Yugr'am salmon in a petty effort to become the city-state's premiere provider of succulent salmon delicacies. After consulting with her clientele, Mother Miounne, proprietress of the Roost, has decided the only way to overcome this blatant provocation is by fighting fire with fire, and showing Gridania once and for all who makes the finest salmon dishes. To do this, however, she requires a large number of fresh Yugr'am salmon caught in the clear waters of Humblehearth, and will pay good coin for each one delivered to her.

In an attempt to document the habitats of different varieties of forest-dwelling wavekin in the area, the Limsa Lominsan Fishermen's Guild is hiring adventurers to travel to the cenotes near Camp Tranquil, fish the waters, and report to the guild their findings.

To make the plaza near the Knot more sightly, the proprietress of the Roost wishes to increase the number of fish on display in the many aquariums. She will pay good coin to any fishers who can catch her monke onke from the waters near Camp Tranquil.

The Drowning Wench's larders are infested with plague rats devouring the alehouse's supplies of rye flour and stone cheese. The proprietor, Baderon Tenfingers, has tracked the vermin back to Camp Bearded Rock, where he believes they make their nest. Locate the warrens and eliminate the rats before they can cause any more damage.

The proprietor, Baderon Tenfingers, has tracked the vermin back to Camp Bearded Rock, where he believes they make their nest. Locate the warrens and eliminate the rats before they can cause any more damage.

The fields near Camp Bearded Rock have become infested with rat moles, whose burrowing has severed the roots of various rare herbs native to the area. To protect the herbs and the livelihood of those who harvest them, seek out and exterminate the subterranean pests.

Hordes of herbivorous rams have invaded the fertile plains of Bearded Rock. If not quelled immediately, their numbers will continue to grow, threatening the region's plant life, and ultimately leading to mass erosion. Hurry to the area's aetheryte camp and help put an end to the problem.

Brigands have broken into one of the Brugaire Consortium's storage warehouses and stolen several crates of plague rat teeth destined for the Alchemists' Guild in Ul'dah. The Consortium cargo ship bound for the desert city will be departing soon, and their representative in Limsa Lominsa has deemed it quicker to simply gather more teeth than attempt to locate the missing items. As luck would have it, an infestation of plague rats has been reported in the vicinity of Camp Bearded Rock.

Soap crafted from rare floatstones has become quite popular amongst the well-to-do wives residing in Limsa Lominsa's Captains Ward. Unfortunately, this has led to a shortage of the aforementioned material and left the city's apothecaries scrambling to procure more. Floatstones are often hoarded by tiny demons known as spriggans, and the Brugaire Consortium will handsomely reward any adventurers who will travel to Bearded Rock and hunt the beasts rumored to hide in the aetheryte camp's outlying areas.
An infestation of plague rats in the hills surrounding Camp Bearded Rock threatens the crops of several independent farmers. Cull the tiny beasts before they wreak their havoc.

An increased number of bark weevil sightings on Limsa Lominsa's southern peninsula has local farmers worried a full-blown infestation may be imminent. In an attempt to prevent this from happening, the Knights of the Barracuda are petitioning adventurers to travel to Camp Bearded Rock and rid the outlying areas of the tiny pests.

In an attempt to strengthen the thalassocracy's hold on the region, the Admiral of Limsa Lominsa has ordered the annexation and colonization of large stretches of unclaimed land in southern La Noscea. Due, however, to the large population of vilekin still residing in the area, very few volunteers have chosen to settle the hills, making it difficult for the city-state to maintain its claim there. The Knights of the Barracuda are petitioning adventurers to travel to Camp Bearded Rock and assist in clearing the outlying areas of any and all possible threats.

Massive clouds of vampiric bats have been spotted by shepherds grazing their sheep near Camp Bearded Rock. Fearing that the bloodthirsty beasts may soon begin attacking their flocks, the shepherds have petitioned the Knights of the Barracuda for their assistance. The Knights, in turn, are seeking adventurers willing to join them in culling the creatures.

A pack of domestic aldgoats has fled its pen and taken refuge in the hills surrounding Cedarwood. To make matters worse, farmers in the area are now claiming the goats are raiding their fields, gorging themselves on the young crops. After dispatching a squad to confront the owner of the livestock and persuade him to retrieve his property, the Knights of the Barracuda discovered that he had already fled, leaving nothing but a squat shack filled with a few iron pots and some moldy bread. Since there is no owner to whom the goats might be returned, the Knights are petitioning adventurers to seek out the animals and eliminate them.

A swarm of giant insect-like creatures has been attacking botanists felling lumber near Cedarwood. Numerous reports suggest these monsters may be none other than dreaded bog yarzons. Investigate the area and eliminate any threat encountered.

A trading ship from Ul'dah scheduled to pick up several crates of prime lowland aldgoat meat has arrived far behind schedule─its cargo long gone foul sitting in a hot seaside warehouse. For fear of offending one of their best (and richest) customers, the Brugaire Consortium is hiring adventurers to travel to Cedarwood and procure a new shipment of fresh aldgoat sirloin before the vessel leaves port again for the mainland.

Many of the families living in sparsely populated Cedarwood have left their homes in fear due to alleged attacks by what the victims describe as “terrible exploding demons.” The Yellowjackets are calling for volunteers to travel to the area and eliminate any and all bomb-like creatures.

A mischievous devilet captured by the Yellowjackets and thrown into the deepest level of the Coral Tower's brig has somehow managed to escape a dungeon that was deemed inescapable. Thalassocratic Navy Sergeant Sylskaetsyn wants the devilet, known for its ability to take on the appearance of an ocean roseling, “permanently silenced” before it has the opportunity to reveal how it accomplished the seemingly impossible deed.

On one of his patrols in Cedarwood, a private serving the Knights of the Barracuda found a piece of parchment containing writings in an ancient dialect of Sharlayan. After further inspection by several log assessors at Mealvaan's Gate, it was discerned that the sheet was actually torn from a stolen copy of the Necrologos―a forbidden tome known to contain wards which bind arcane demons within its pages. The assessors believe there may still be more unclaimed pages and are asking adventurers to find them, put to rest any beasts summoned therefrom, and then destroy the parchment.
